blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The friend of lawyer Manases Carpio testified to the Senate Impeachment Court that he has no proof of pitching in for the P200,000 meal in Japan. He made the statement after he said that the purchase was made for 11 individuals. Carpio’s friend – Atty. Anel Antero – was presented as a witness
